payload.summary: Unified RCA for HEAD.lock recurrence (5 cycles, invalidated worktree-only hypothesis — c56 single-session evidence points to rapid sequential git commit racing on HEAD.lock or hook crash) and worktree orphan pathology (separate issue, SDK at-exit gap). 4 hypotheses prioritized. Diagnostic plan (GIT_TRACE + hook timing probe + lock-size logging + filesystem layer test). 7 c57+ tasks proposed (T1-T2 investigation first, T3-T4 fix gated on T1, T5-T6 worktree gc independent).
